# Targeters

<!-- Generated by DocumentationTest. Do not edit by hand:
     run `mvn test -Dbestiary.docs.write=true` after changing a declaration. -->

To whom, or where. Every targeter also accepts `limit`, `sort` and `filter`, which the engine applies rather than the targeter — so a third-party targeter gets them free and cannot forget the `max_targets` cap.

39 built in.

### `@self`

The caster.

Produces: `entity`

| Parameter | Aliases | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | — | `0` | maximum targets after sorting |
| `sort` | — | `none` | nearest, farthest, random, threat, lowest_health, highest_health |
| `filter` | — | **required** | a condition list every target must pass |
